prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a parking lot collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1288; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The rear bumper cover is cracked across its center and the left taillight assembly is broken, with scuffing running along the left quarter panel. The crush pattern and paint transfer line up with the reported low-speed strike in the lot, and nothing in the inspection suggests older damage to this vehicle. The plan is to replace the bumper cover and taillight assembly, refinish the quarter panel, and perform the related alignment checks. The labor hours submitted are in line with this scope of work, and the parts and invoices reviewed show no duplicated or repeated line items. Recommend approval as written.
